_about: Test locations on the vanilla map (world 'Muldraugh, KY'). Coordinates are tiles; whole numbers = tile centre; the point is a free floor square to stand on. 'containers' counts tile objects with containers per floor inside 'area' (the building's metagrid bounds, or the open area) and is what scripts/probe_locations.py re-checks; furniture is map data, the items inside are random per world. Only add an entry after standing there and confirming its contents in game (PZLab.findObjects or a scan + a screenshot), and record the game version in 'verified'.

spawn-house.about: Riverside single-storey house; lab.json's default world start. Stands in the living room, kitchen to the east.

contents.z0: kitchen: 4 counters, 5 overhead cabinets, stove, fridge (fridge + freezer), microwave; 4 dressers, 4 wardrobes, 2 shelves, 2 dishes cabinets, 2 filing cabinets, 2 desks, 2 bins, side table, small box, metal shelves; propane barbecue outside at 6125,5481

two-storey-house.about: Riverside two-storey house, ground floor: stands in the kitchen. Stairs up at 6080,5429-5431; upstairs is 'two-storey-house-upstairs'.

contents.z0: kitchen: 8 counters, stove, fridge (fridge + freezer), microwave, dishwasher, bin; laundry: washer, 2 dryers, metal shelves; closet: metal shelves, small box; living room: desk, dresser; barbecue outside at 6077,5421
contents.z1: hall: 2 dishes cabinets, shelves; bedroom: 2 wardrobes, side table; kids bedrooms: dresser, 2 side tables, shelves; bathrooms: counter, medicine cabinet; closet: metal shelves, small box, 2 cardboard boxes

two-storey-house-upstairs.about: Upstairs hall of 'two-storey-house'. From here lab.hover reached 10-12 of the 16 upstairs containers in two runs (the rest are behind walls).

grocery.about: Riverside grocery, between the shelf rows; the parking lot is just east ('parking-lot').

contents.z0: 17 shelves, 2 magazine shelves, 3 grocer stands, 3 bakery display cases, 4 fridges + 2 freezers, 5 counters, cash register, 3 bins, small box; storage room: 2 metal shelves, 2 crates; newspaper box outside

parking-lot.about: Open asphalt lot east of the grocery: 'area' (12 x 16 tiles) is clear ground (PZLab.findOpenArea). A car (6145,5379 E), a pickup (6151,5381 S) and a van (6145,5388 E) spawned there were all in view and hovered at zoom 1.

contents.z0: nothing: open ground for vehicles, corpses and floor items
